package.description: Headless command-line scanner to find duplicated video and image files based on similarity.

en-US.description: Headless command-line scanner to find duplicated video and image files based on similarity.
en-US.longDescription:
Video Duplicate Finder is a cross-platform tool to find duplicated video (and image) files on hard disk based on similarity. Unlike other duplicate finders, it also finds duplicates that have a different resolution, frame rate, or even a watermark.
This package provides the headless CLI for scripting and automation. Scanning is fast, rescans are incremental, and duplicates are matched by similarity rather than only by hash, with partial clip detection through audio fingerprinting and optional local AI matching, all running fully offline. A desktop GUI and a web UI are available from the project releases.
en-US.name: Video Duplicate Finder CLI

zh-CN.description: 基于相似度查找重复视频和图像文件的无界面命令行扫描器。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Video Duplicate Finder 是一款跨平台工具，可基于相似度在硬盘上查找重复的视频（和图像）文件。与其他查重软件不同，它还能找出分辨率、帧率不同甚至带有水印的重复项。
本包提供用于脚本自动化的无界面命令行工具。扫描速度快，重扫为增量式，重复项按相似度匹配而不是仅靠哈希，并提供基于音频指纹的部分片段检测和可选的本地 AI 匹配，全部在本地离线运行。桌面 GUI 和 Web UI 可从项目发布页获取。
